tools.name: twilio_get_account
tools.description: Get the Twilio account for the connected credentials: friendly name, status (active/suspended/closed), type, and created date. Good first call to confirm which account is connected. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}.json.

tools.name: twilio_get_balance
tools.description: Get the prepaid account balance and currency. Trial and postpaid accounts may return a zero or not-applicable balance. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Balance.json.

tools.name: twilio_list_messages
tools.description: List SMS, MMS and WhatsApp messages on the account, newest first. Filter by recipient, sender and sent date. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Messages.json.

tools.name: twilio_get_message
tools.description: Get one message by SID: status (queued, sent, delivered, undelivered, failed), error code, price and segment count. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Messages/{Sid}.json.

tools.name: twilio_send_sms
tools.description: SEND a real SMS (or MMS when media_url is set) from the account to a phone number. This costs money and reaches a real person; it cannot be undone. Use a From number you own, or a messaging_service_sid. Twilio API: POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Messages.json.

tools.name: twilio_list_calls
tools.description: List voice calls on the account, newest first. Filter by number, status and start date. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls.json.

tools.name: twilio_get_call
tools.description: Get one call by SID: status, direction, duration, price, start and end times. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls/{Sid}.json.

tools.name: twilio_end_call
tools.description: END a call that is in progress or ringing by setting its status to completed. The caller and callee are disconnected. Repeating it on an ended call is harmless. Twilio API: POST /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls/{Sid}.json with Status=completed.

tools.name: twilio_list_incoming_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the Twilio phone numbers the account owns: number, friendly name, capabilities (voice, SMS, MMS) and configured webhook URLs. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/IncomingPhoneNumbers.json.

tools.name: twilio_list_conferences
tools.description: List voice conferences on the account, with friendly name and status (init, in-progress, completed). Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Conferences.json.

tools.name: twilio_list_recordings
tools.description: List call and conference recordings on the account: SID, duration, status and the parent call or conference. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Recordings.json.

tools.name: twilio_get_usage_records
tools.description: Get billed usage and cost for a period by category (for example sms-outbound, calls, phonenumbers). Use start_date and end_date to choose the period. Twilio API: GET /2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Usage/Records.json.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "twilio_get_account" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: twilio_list_messages, twilio_get_message, twilio_list_incoming_phone_numbers · Private data: twilio_get_account, twilio_get_usage_records · Public sink: twilio_list_messages, twilio_send_sms, twilio_end_call, twilio_list_incoming_phone_numbers, twilio_get_usage_records.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: twilio_list_messages, twilio_get_message, twilio_list_incoming_phone_numbers · Private data: twilio_get_account, twilio_get_usage_records · Public sink: twilio_list_messages, twilio_send_sms, twilio_end_call, twilio_list_incoming_phone_numbers, twilio_get_usage_records

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
